assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement_zh: 提交的 SITE_BOUNDARY 与 KEY_AREA 以 OSM 实测京张走廊为中心线重建，面积拟合至公告约值；仓库原临时矩形保留在 constraints.geojson。
assumptions.statement_en: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREAs are rebuilt on the surveyed corridor centreline with areas fitted to the announced values; the repository rectangles are retained in constraints.geojson.
assumptions.rationale_zh: 公告把总体设计范围定义为“京张遗址公园周边 1—2 公里”，是以走廊为参照的定义；原矩形北段位于实测走廊以东约 2 km，未包含走廊本体。
assumptions.verification_needed_zh: 取得官方红线后必须整链重算，并重新校核两套几何的差异。

assumptions.statement_zh: 走廊现状东西向连续穿越计 6 处、平均间距约 2038 m、最大空档约 2160 m，基于 OSM 开放数据统计。
assumptions.statement_en: Six continuous east-west crossings, ~2038 m mean spacing and a ~2160 m largest gap, counted from OSM open data.
assumptions.rationale_zh: 用于量化现状横向连通条件，作为缝合口选址与分类（改造/新增）的依据。
assumptions.verification_needed_zh: 须由交通专业以现场调查复核，OSM 未计入围墙、权属与通行管制。
